note: The OLG has extensive, well-organized coverage of non-citizen eligibility under SNAP > Eligibility Requirements > Noncitizen, with dedicated pages for each major category FNS 822 requires. Specifically: (1) Eligible Qualified Noncitizen categories are enumerated on the Noncitizen Introduction page (Cuban/Haitian Entrants, Legal Permanent Residents, COFA citizens). (2) The LPR page lists 5-year waiting period and exemptions: children under 18, 40 qualifying quarters, disabled noncitizens, veterans/active duty, elderly (born on/before 8/22/31 lawfully residing on 8/22/96). (3) Each exemption has its own detailed sub-page with eligibility criteria and BEACON procedures (Veterans and Active Duty Personnel, Disabled Noncitizens, Verifying 40 Quarters, Citizens from COFA Nations). (4) Non-applicant/opt-out provisions are covered on the Noncitizen Opt-Out page with BEACON coding instructions. (5) Verification uses SAVE/USCIS (detailed procedures on the SAVE page), and QCHS for 40 qualifying quarters verification (with SSA integration). (6) American Indian born in Canada/Mexico is covered under Citizenship Overview with specific verification documents. (7) U.S. Nationals (American Samoa/Swain's Island) covered under Citizenship. Two minor notes: the OLG lists Amerasians as an 'Ineligible Legal Noncitizen Status' in their standalone designation, though LPRs who adjusted from that status appear covered on the LPR page; and the Hmong/Highland Laotian tribal member category from FNS was not found in search results (though the LPR eligibility list may include it in content not returned by the search). The FNS-specific requirement for DOD-only documentation for military verification was not explicitly found, though the Veterans and Active Duty Personnel page likely addresses verification. Overall, the OLG provides comprehensive coverage with both policy and BEACON procedures for all major non-citizen eligibility pathways.
